confirmed_findings.title: Analysis remains a local rolling window; shared range and both request bounds are absent
confirmed_findings.mechanism: windowDays is local state. Report/ghost hooks serialize only vehicle_id/window_days (plus report limit/offset), accept no startInstant/endInstantExclusive, and the actual route is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS. Showing returned window.from/to is useful provenance but does not implement header range selection.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: For /ownership/driver-attribution, source route lookup has range=false; inspect the two query constructors: neither can transmit an independently chosen start and end. No API request or endpoint capability was tested.
confirmed_findings.fix: Integration must establish explicit-bound/full-population server support, then typed hooks, real route registration and useRangeState adoption. Preserve 30/60/90/180/365-day options, selected vehicle, DST/timezone semantics; do not remove functioning local scope before replacement.
confirmed_findings.history: Reconfirmed audit-page-156 architecture range issue; source migration completed, not reopened.
confirmed_findings.confidence: confirmed source mechanism; no runtime claim

confirmed_findings.title: Ghost empty state claims known-driver coverage without selection or samples
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The same clear-window message is used whenever ghosts.length is zero. vehicleId=null disables the query; sourceEnabled=false immediately selects empty. A returned scanned=0/ghosts=[] also selects empty. Neither case establishes that every drive fits a known profile or that unknown-driver activity was excluded.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: Symbolic case A: vehicleId=null, data=undefined, isLoading=false. Case B: selected vehicle, returned {scanned:0,ghosts:[]}. Follow branches to the literal every-scanned-drive-fits-known-profile claim. No real identity data accessed.
confirmed_findings.fix: Separate selection-required, unresolved/paused, zero-scanned and supported no-flags states. State behavioral flag absence, not proof of physical identity or complete coverage. Preserve nonzero scanned population and source retry.
confirmed_findings.history: Reconfirmed historical audit-page-156 unknown/success concern; existing GhostDrivesPanel tests only cover scanned=24 clear state.
confirmed_findings.confidence: confirmed source mechanism; no runtime claim

confirmed_findings.title: Ghost table hides Label and specialist fields below md without a detail path
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Ghost table supplies mobileColumns=[drive,score,reason] but no mobilePresentation, expandable or row action alternative. Shared DataTable adds hidden md:table-cell to trip, deviation and assign. Distance/duration, deviation/confidence and Label are therefore not reachable on this source mobile branch. Main-page cluster/profile/fingerprint adapters do retain their details and actions; this finding is only the direct Ghost support.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: Below md with at least one synthetic flagged row, apply colHiddenClass to trip/deviation/assign. mobileEnabled=false prevents the Quick view adapter. Inspect source only; no viewport/browser exercised.
confirmed_findings.fix: Use the existing mobile table summary/details adapter and inline Label action with all original fields available in details. Retain ownership-ghost-drives and loaded export scope; verify 44px targets under a separately authorized native check.
confirmed_findings.history: Main-page historical mobile gaps are repaired in current source; Ghost support remains distinct.
confirmed_findings.confidence: confirmed source mechanism; no runtime claim

confirmed_findings.title: Every unrecognized attribution source is presented as inferred
confirmed_findings.mechanism: DriveFingerprint.source is an open string. The two-way equality classifies every non-labelled value as inferred, including unknown/new classifications, thereby asserting a provenance that source did not establish. Ambiguous remains a separate badge, correctly preserved.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: Take a symbolic fingerprint with source=unknown (or any future nonempty value other than labelled/inferred); the render branch produces the localized inferred badge. No actual attribution or backend response was queried.
confirmed_findings.fix: Explicitly map confirmed labelled and inferred values; render an honest neutral unknown/unrecognized fallback for other values without narrowing the public source contract or asserting identity.
confirmed_findings.history: New bounded source finding, separate from the repaired VerdictBadge unknown-verdict fallback.
confirmed_findings.confidence: confirmed source mechanism; no runtime claim

confirmed_findings.title: Chart data discards precision before preference-aware display
confirmed_findings.mechanism: share_pct and aggression_score are converted through toFixed(1) into rounded numbers in shareData. Chart, tooltip and accessible data table all consume that rounded array; later fmtNumber/formatPct cannot recover precision requested by the user. Table and summary source values are otherwise raw.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: For symbolic share_pct=12.3456 and aggression_score=34.5678 with precision=3, chart data becomes 12.3 and 34.6, while source-aware formatting elsewhere can retain additional digits. This is numerical source derivation, not a rendered test.
confirmed_findings.fix: Keep raw share_pct/aggression_score in chart data; format only ticks/tooltips/table output at the display boundary with effective preferences. Preserve /100 versus % distinctions and hidden-series IDs.
confirmed_findings.history: Current table/tooltip unit distinction is repaired; precision loss remains a separate mechanism.
confirmed_findings.confidence: confirmed source mechanism; no runtime claim

confirmed_findings.title: Six accent choices expose raw English option labels
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The persisted accent identifiers cyan/emerald/amber/purple/rose/indigo are used directly as option labels, bypassing t(). The Select forwards opt.label into option text. User-entered profile names are data and are not this finding.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: In any non-English locale, inspect ACCENTS.map: value=accent and label=accent remain the six untranslated English identifiers. No native popup opened.
confirmed_findings.fix: Keep persisted values unchanged; localize visible labels. Parent must serialize any needed six canonical accent-copy leaves and generated catalog integration; worker edits none.
confirmed_findings.confidence: confirmed source mechanism; no runtime claim

confirmed_findings.title: Separation summary caption bypasses existing localized verdict labels
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The metric context is raw report.separation_verdict. OwnershipBrief forwards it into OperationalBrief metrics unchanged, so known English machine classifications are visible in summary/details even though the nearby VerdictBadge localizes those same values. Arbitrary source prose must not be blindly translated or recased.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: Use symbolic separation_verdict=strong with a translated ownership.verdict.strong catalog: interpretation Badge resolves t(), summary context remains strong. No locale/browser test executed.
confirmed_findings.fix: Reuse the existing known-verdict localized keys for known summary classifications while preserving neutral text for genuinely unrecognized source values. No new registry or strength threshold.
confirmed_findings.history: Shared VerdictBadge localization is completed and accepted; this caller context was not covered by that owner.
confirmed_findings.confidence: confirmed source mechanism; no runtime claim

confirmed_findings.title: Known quality classification is rendered as an untranslated enum
confirmed_findings.mechanism: DataQuality.status is the closed sufficient/limited/insufficient vocabulary. EvidencePanel prints quality.status verbatim; localized quality labels elsewhere do not translate this visible badge. The existing semantic variant mapping itself is retained, not inferred from numeric thresholds.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: For a non-English locale and symbolic status=limited, the badge child is the literal machine string rather than ownership.verdict.limited. No actual sample data or locale mount accessed.
confirmed_findings.fix: Use existing canonical known-status labels (or reuse the appropriate current domain presenter) without changing sufficient/limited/insufficient tones, reasons, samples, bounds or evidence rows. This is a shared ownership EvidencePanel need, not a page-local clone.
confirmed_findings.history: Reconfirmed historical shared EvidencePanel localization gap; unrelated advanced-intelligence EvidencePanel owners are not this owner.
confirmed_findings.confidence: confirmed source mechanism; no runtime claim

confirmed_findings.title: Ghost score and deviation declare sorting but the caller never wires it
confirmed_findings.mechanism: Both columns set sortable=true, but GhostDrivesPanel supplies neither onSort nor sorted data/sortKey/sortDir. Shared DataTable mounts interactive sorting only when col.sortable && onSort. Two inert declarations are one caller-wiring mechanism, counted once. Main-page cluster and fingerprint sorting is wired correctly.
confirmed_findings.source_only_repro: Inspect the Ghost score/deviation column declarations, then DataTable caller and shared conditional: neither sort header can mount a sort action. Source-only; no clicking or runtime test.
confirmed_findings.fix: Wire existing typed caller-owned sorting on raw score/distance_ratio with original order before user interaction and stable drive IDs. Preserve confidence fields and loaded export scope.
confirmed_findings.history: Reconfirmed Ghost portion of historical inert-sort issue; main page portion repaired.
